uncertainties: In bright light the program does nothing: none of the functions that follow the line in the light (avoidWalls, driveInTheDark, stopAtWall, followLine) is ever called.
Because those functions are never called, the program never reads the obstacle sensors, though it has code for them.
In the dark on the plain floor the line tracker reads about 83, neither below 40 nor above 88: the robot would stand still there, and you didn't say what it should do.
The line follower steers a little at a time (curves at low power), so in a tunnel it needs a little room around the line.
